description: Filesystem weight ceilings for the built public/ tree. Numbers consume S15/T69 outcomes (image weight after the adaptive ladder) with headroom; they are not invented Lighthouse score thresholds.
notes: Audio/video bodies are out of the image budget (a track recording is intentionally large).
search-index.json has its own ceiling in check-search-index.py.

CSS ceiling is 70 KiB (T208, 2026-09-16): 67 746 bytes measured in the preview build (site.min 52 864 + declassified.min 14 882), headroom 3 934 bytes (5.8%). Sized so a typical feature (0.5–2 KB in the T181→T208 range) fits and a layout-scale change (4–5 KB) stops at the gate.

/sw.js is outside the JS ceiling by owner decision (T226, 2026-09-15): it does not block rendering and is fetched only on Service Worker registration. Since T227 it is the cleanup worker that retires that layer.
